svg.title: D2 From a view to an operator
svg.desc: A view gives a positive kernel K_β on sites; Sinkhorn scaling makes it a symmetric P whose rows and columns all sum to 1 [M3]. The eigenfunctions ψ_i of P are patterns over the same sites; spectral gaps delimit blocks B. Constructed 16-site toy, β = 5.

text.tspan: From a view to an operator
: each eigenfunction is a pattern over the same 16 sites
